title: 第七章 二十三年我又回来了第八章 诡异黑气疑似中邪
slug: 修炼一天抵十年莫欺老年穷
lines: “这不就得了。”
沈七轻笑起来，道：“您若是早点同意，也能早点摆脱苦海不是，放心，这祖宅一卖，您那孙子、孙女，没准就突然回来了！”
“我要看到继宗和剑华回来！”
老太太怒喝，道：“他们一日没回来，我一日不会卖！”
沈七脸上一笑，回头道：“吴兄弟，把人带进来吧！”
外面，传来脚步声音。
一身躯魁梧，穿着黑色短褂的汉子，满脸笑意，手中提着一男一女两个身影，从外面走了过来。
那女子穿着新式的女学生装，惊慌大喝。
男子则是早已昏迷，一动不动。
“剑华！继宗！”
老太太和赵秀珠露出惊色，连忙开口。
那魁梧壮汉随手一丢，将他们扔在了地上。
名为韩剑华的女学生连忙快速向着老太太和秀珠跑了过去。
赵秀珠则是迅速来到那昏迷的儿子近前，惊慌道：“继宗，继宗你怎么了？”
她连忙抬头，向着眼前三人怒目而视，道：“你们把我儿子怎么了？”
“这可不怪我们，我们找到他时，他就已经是这样了。”
沈七露出笑意，道：“老太太，你们把契约签了吧，这里是300大洋，够你们好好生活得了！”
他随手取出了300大洋，直接丢了过去。
一侧的李麻子则是直接取出契约，向前走了过去，笑道：“老太太，您这边还是把手印给按了吧。”
“不能按。”
一道干涩沙哑的声音突然响起。
没有任何征兆。
就如同突然出现的一样。
哪怕是那位练到明劲巅峰的魁梧壮汉，也是脸色一变，猛然回头。
沈七、李麻子也全部皱眉，迅速回头。
这一回头，顿时眉头皱起。
只见一个身穿黑色长褂、黑色长裤，满头白发的老登，不知何时出现在了这里，脸上沟壑纵横，好似刀削。
那魁梧壮汉很快暗松口气，露出冷笑。
还以为是什么高手呢？
妈的，一个半死老登！
“老东西，这里有你什么事？”
魁梧壮汉吴铁柱森然冷笑，大步前冲，道：“想管闲事，也不看看你是什么德行，给我死一边去！”
他一巴掌向着林玄那边狂扇而去。
但手掌还未扇出，林玄早已后发先至。
苍老手掌快的不可思议，几乎超出肉眼观看范围，掌峰边缘带着一股白色气流，诡异而又恐怖。
content_en:
"That's it."
Shen Qi chuckled lightly and said: "If you had agreed earlier, you would have been able to get out of the sea of misery earlier. Don't worry, once this ancestral home is sold, your grandson and granddaughter may suddenly come back!"
"I want to see Jizong and Jianhua come back!"
The old lady shouted angrily, "If they don't come back for a day, I won't sell it for a day!"
"It's done."
Shen Qi smiled and turned around: "Brother Wu, bring people in!"
Outside, there was the sound of footsteps.
A burly man wearing a black short coat came over from outside with a smile on his face and two figures, a man and a woman, in his hands.
"Mom! Grandma!!!"
The woman was wearing a new schoolgirl uniform and shouted in panic.
The man was already unconscious and motionless.
"Jianhua! Ji Zong!"
The old lady and Zhao Xiuzhu looked shocked and spoke quickly.
The burly and strong man casually threw them to the ground.
The female student named Han Jianhua quickly ran towards the old lady and Xiuzhu.
Zhao Xiuzhu quickly came to the unconscious son and said in panic: "Jizong, what's wrong with you, Jizong?"
She quickly raised her head, glared at the three people in front of her, and said, "What did you do to my son?"
"It's not our fault, he was already like this when we found him."
Shen Qi smiled and said: "Old lady, please sign the contract. This is 300 oceans, which is enough for you to live a good life!"
He casually took out 300 yuan and threw it directly.
Li Mazi, who was on one side, took out the contract directly, walked forward, and said with a smile: "Old lady, you'd better put your fingerprints on it."
"Can't press."
A dry and hoarse voice suddenly sounded.
There are no signs.
It was like it suddenly appeared.
Even the burly man who had reached the peak of Ming Jin's strength suddenly changed his expression and turned around suddenly.
Shen Qi and Li Mazi also frowned and quickly turned back.
When he turned around, his brows suddenly furrowed.
I saw an old man wearing a black coat, black trousers, and white hair. He didn't know when he appeared here. His face was criss-crossed, like a knife.
The burly man quickly breathed a sigh of relief and sneered.
Did you think he was an expert?
Damn it, a half-dead old man!
"Old guy, what's the business of you here?"
The burly and strong man Wu Tiezhu sneered, strode forward, and said: "If you want to meddle in other people's business, I don't even know what kind of virtue you have. Just die!"
He slapped Lin Xuan wildly.
But before his palm could be fanned out, Lin Xuan had already arrived first.
The old palm was incredibly fast, almost beyond the range of the naked eye. There was a white airflow on the edge of the palm, which was strange and terrifying.
Bang! ! !
title_en: Chapter 7: Twenty-three years later, I’m back again. Chapter 8: The strange black energy is suspected of being possessed by evil spirits.
